record.field: # Odoo's own dialog for a new API key of the current user, behind its # password check. action = env.user.api_key_wizard()

# Opens the AnythingMCP setup with this Odoo's address and database filled # in, plus a marker that the link comes from this module. The API key is # never part of it: the user pastes it on the AnythingMCP page. # Self-hosted AnythingMCP: set the system parameter anythingmcp_connector.url. params = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo() base = (params.get_param('anythingmcp_connector.url') or 'https://cloud.anythingmcp.com').rstrip('/') values = [ ('prefill.ODOO_URL', (params.get_param('web.base.url') or '').rstrip('/')), ('prefill.ODOO_DB', env.cr.dbname), ('source', 'odoo_module'), ] # Percent-encoding by hand: the sandbox has no urllib. unreserved = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-._~' pairs = [] for name, value in values: encoded = '' for char in value: if char in unreserved: encoded += char else: for byte in char.encode('utf-8'): encoded += '%%%02X' % byte pairs.append(name + '=' + encoded) # Odoo 19 and newer (Odoo Online included) have the JSON-2 API, which is # AnythingMCP's "odoo" connector. action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_url', 'url': base + '/connectors/setup/odoo?' + '&'.join(pairs), 'target': 'new', }
